domain_setting: A welcoming secondary-school and university learning environment with classrooms, specialist rooms, a library, lecture spaces, and outdoor campus paths.
recurring_scale_anchors: Use familiar classroom furniture, plain unlettered books and paper, and age-appropriate students as recurring scale cues.
Use a shared school palette of pale paper, slate-blue furniture, sage accents, coral, and warm gold.
Make each subject distinct through its characteristic tool, specimen, or activity rather than labels or writing.
Keep people and classroom objects comfortably inside the 304 by 192 stage with clear bold silhouettes.

polysemy_resolution_table.class: A school lesson group with a teacher and students, rather than a social category or type.
polysemy_resolution_table.course: A planned program of study, shown through a learner following a sequence of connected lessons, rather than a physical route.
polysemy_resolution_table.degree / degree (qualification) (same se: A university qualification, represented by graduation and an academic certificate, rather than an angle or amount.
polysemy_resolution_table.education: Teaching and learning in a school setting, represented by a teacher guiding a learner.
polysemy_resolution_table.english: The school subject of English language and literature, represented through reading and language study without written words.
polysemy_resolution_table.fail: Not passing a school assessment, shown through a disappointed student receiving a returned paper with a low visual mark, without text or numerals.
polysemy_resolution_table.grade: A year level in elementary or secondary school, not an exam score.
polysemy_resolution_table.graduate: A person who has completed university and wears a cap and gown, not the act of graduating.
polysemy_resolution_table.major: A student's main field of university study, not the adjective meaning large or important.
polysemy_resolution_table.pass (succeed): Succeed in an exam or assessment, not move past an object.
polysemy_resolution_table.review: Study previously learned material again, using notes and a book, not a public evaluation.
polysemy_resolution_table.revise: Study and improve one's notes in preparation for an exam, rather than edit a published document.
polysemy_resolution_table.resit: Take an exam again after an earlier unsuccessful attempt.
polysemy_resolution_table.sit an exam: Take a written school exam while seated at a desk.
polysemy_resolution_table.study a subject: A student actively learning one school subject from a book, model, or instructor.
polysemy_resolution_table.test: A school assessment on paper, distinguished from the action of sitting the exam.
polysemy_resolution_table.thesis: A long university research project with books, source notes, and a formal bound document, not a general opinion.

contrast_notes.architecture / engineering / design and: Architecture centers on building plans and a model; engineering on a mechanism or bridge structure; design and technology on sketching and making a prototype.
contrast_notes.biology / chemistry / physics / geology: Biology uses living specimens; chemistry uses glassware and a safe experiment; physics uses a force or light apparatus; geology uses rock strata; science is a broader school inquiry scene.
contrast_notes.business studies / economics: Business studies uses a small enterprise ledger and planning activity; economics uses a market exchange and supply-demand comparison without charts containing text.
contrast_notes.teacher / lecturer / professor: Teacher is in a school classroom; lecturer addresses a hall; professor works and teaches in a university academic setting.
contrast_notes.college / university / school / campus: School shows a K-12 building; college a small tertiary institution; university a larger academic complex; campus a walkable outdoor grounds scene.
contrast_notes.essay / thesis / diploma / degree: Essay is a short student paper; thesis is a substantial university research work; diploma is a physical certificate; degree is the completed university qualification.
contrast_notes.exam / test / sit an exam / resit: Exam shows assessment materials; test is a short paper assessment; sit an exam shows the learner taking it; resit shows a second attempt after study.
contrast_notes.review / revise / studying / study a sub: Review revisits notes, revise actively improves notes, studying is quiet independent work, study a subject includes subject-specific material, homework happens at home.
